exportDialog:
- dialog "Save as an audio file":
  - banner:
    - heading "Save as an audio file" [level=2]
    - button "Close Save as an audio file"
  - paragraph: Your mix current mix, 4 songs, about 4 min. FLAC.
  - paragraph: From Morning Light to Neon Rain. Save captures exactly the songs and transitions shown for this current mix at the moment you start. Later edits will not change the exported file.
  - group: Review proposed order (4 songs)
  - list "Export progress":
    - listitem: Prepare transitions
    - listitem: Create the FLAC file
    - listitem: Download your mix
  - paragraph: 3 of 3 transitions ready. Everything’s ready.
  - button "Save it"
  - paragraph: Your original songs aren’t touched.
  - paragraph:
    - text: You can close this and it keeps going. Find it again under Activity, or in
    - link "Workspace":
      - /url: /workshop
    - text: .
